readme_excerpt: Jev Ultrafast ⚡ > [!IMPORTANT] > The Browser Use Cloud waitlist is open. Get early access to ultrafast browser agents in the cloud. > Join the waitlist → A browser agent with a dynamic, indexed action space. Give it one goal. TypeSafe's Jev picks an operation and an element. A small LLM writes text only when the operation is TYPETEXT. Zürich → London on Google Flights in 7.1 seconds. One natural-language goal, actual text generation, and loading waits included. Watch the MP4 · Measurements · Re…
